verdict.rationale: Fireflies ships a broad first-party GraphQL API with bearer auth and introspection, covering transcript listing and detail, audio upload with completion webhooks, analytics, active meetings, audit events, and AskFred, plus MCP tools that take actions such as sharing, moving meetings, and creating soundbites. However, nothing in the evidence claims UI–API parity, and several UI features have no documented API equivalent, including the rules engine, live bot invites and real-time notes, and admin and privacy settings. missing for 10: an explicit UI/API parity statement, documented API coverage of workspace settings, automation rules and live meeting controls, and independent corroboration of coverage depth.
